cover:amazing_animals.p: A small fluffy ginger kitten detective in a tiny deerstalker hat peering through a magnifying glass at a cheetah, an octopus and a platypus gathered on a sunny savanna riverbank

cover:pet_care.p: A small fluffy ginger kitten detective in a tiny deerstalker hat checking on a happy puppy, a hamster in its cage and a goldfish bowl in a cozy sunlit living room

pet_care:0.p: A cheerful girl hugging her fluffy cat on a sofa while a happy dog rests its head on her lap, warm evening lamp light, cozy home

pet_care:1.p: A boy pouring fresh clean water into a shiny bowl next to a bowl of pet food while a hungry cat waits politely, bright kitchen floor

pet_care:2.p: A worried puppy looking at a kitchen table with chocolate bar, grapes and onion, a kind girl gently moving the food out of reach

pet_care:3.p: A sleepy hamster curled up in a nest of wood shavings during the day beside a clean aquarium with colorful little fish and green plants

pet_care:4.p: A boy walking a happy dog on a leash through an autumn park, carrying a small cleanup bag, golden leaves falling

pet_care:5.p: A friendly veterinarian with a stethoscope gently examining a calm puppy on a clinic table while a child holds its paw

cover:wild_help.p: A small fluffy ginger kitten detective in a tiny deerstalker hat hanging a wooden bird feeder on a snowy branch while tits and bullfinches gather around

wild_help:0.p: Children hanging a wooden bird feeder on a snowy tree, round little tits and red-breasted bullfinches flying in, soft winter morning

wild_help:1.p: A close-up of a bird feeder tray with sunflower seeds, oat flakes and a piece of unsalted lard, a blue tit pecking happily

wild_help:2.p: A fluffy fledgling sparrow sitting in the grass under a tree while its parent brings a worm, a child watching quietly from a distance

wild_help:3.p: A curious hedgehog sniffing around a garden at dusk while a girl watches from afar, a saucer of milk pushed aside

wild_help:4.p: A boy stopping at a safe distance from a young fox in the forest edge, pointing it out to his mom who holds a phone

wild_help:5.p: A wooden birdhouse on a tree and a small bug hotel made of sticks and hollow stems with bees visiting, sunny summer garden

cover:eco_care.p: A small fluffy ginger kitten detective in a tiny deerstalker hat picking up litter in a sunny green forest clearing and sorting it into colorful recycling bins

eco_care:0.p: A plastic bottle lying in a forest clearing surrounded by grown trees and moss, an hourglass beside it suggesting a very long time

eco_care:1.p: Plastic bottles traveling along a factory conveyor and turning into a cozy fleece jacket and a new notebook, cheerful bright factory

eco_care:2.p: Two kids sorting rinsed bottles, cardboard boxes, glass jars and tin cans into differently colored recycling containers in a courtyard

eco_care:3.p: A girl dropping old batteries into a special collection box at a supermarket entrance, keeping them away from an ordinary trash bin

eco_care:4.p: A boy turning off a running tap while brushing his teeth and switching off the light as he leaves the bathroom

eco_care:5.p: A family pouring water from a bucket over the remains of a campfire in a lakeside pine forest at sunset, safely put out

cover:plants.p: A small fluffy ginger kitten detective in a tiny deerstalker hat examining a tiny green sprout through a magnifying glass in a blooming garden

plants:0.p: A sequence of a seed in soil sprouting a root, then a little green shoot, then a young tree, side by side under the sun

plants:1.p: A friendly green leaf soaking up sunlight while water rises from roots and air swirls in, tiny sparkles of sugar forming inside

cover:weather.p: A small fluffy ginger kitten detective in a tiny deerstalker hat holding an umbrella and looking up at a bright rainbow after a summer rain

weather:2.p: A family hurrying from an open field into a cozy house as dark storm clouds gather, a lone tree standing far away

cover:world_peoples.p: A small fluffy ginger kitten detective in a tiny deerstalker hat spinning a big colorful globe surrounded by children in traditional clothes from different countries

world_peoples:0.p: A crowd of smiling children of many nationalities standing around a giant globe, waving hello to each other

world_peoples:1.p: Children greeting each other in different ways: a bow, palms pressed together, two kids gently touching noses and foreheads, sunny schoolyard

world_peoples:2.p: A festive table with pizza, sushi, tacos, dumplings, pancakes and a bowl of borscht, kids reaching for treats

world_peoples:3.p: A cheerful collage of festivals: red paper lanterns and a dancing dragon, kids throwing colorful powder, and a stack of pancakes by a winter bonfire

world_peoples:4.p: Two kids from different cultures shaking hands and trading snacks with curious friendly smiles in a park

world_peoples:5.p: A huge map-shaped landscape stretching from a night city in the west to a sunrise over volcanoes in the east

cover:kindness.p: A small fluffy ginger kitten detective in a tiny deerstalker hat holding a door open for a grandma carrying groceries, warm sunny street

kindness:0.p: A girl politely leaning toward an elderly man struggling with a heavy bag, offering help with an open hand

kindness:1.p: A schoolboy giving up his bus seat to a smiling grandmother with a cane, other passengers smiling

kindness:2.p: A child offering an elbow to a smiling blind man with a white cane at a crosswalk, a calm guide dog beside them

kindness:3.p: An older girl helping a little first-grader with a big backpack find the way down a school hallway

kindness:4.p: A group of young volunteers planting saplings and walking shelter dogs in a sunny park

kindness:5.p: A girl handing a drawing to her classmate who smiles widely, little glowing hearts floating in the air

cover:inventions.p: A small fluffy ginger kitten detective in a tiny deerstalker hat in a cluttered inventor workshop, examining a glowing light bulb and a toy airplane

inventions:0.p: A cheerful landscape with a wind turbine, solar panels and a dam sending glowing energy along power lines into a cozy house

inventions:2.p: A cutaway of a fridge showing cold blue air swirling around food inside and warm air escaping from coils at the back

inventions:3.p: A passenger airplane soaring above fluffy clouds, gentle swirls of air flowing over its curved wings, kids waving from below

inventions:4.p: Many computers around the world connected by glowing lines, tiny parcels zipping along different paths between them

cover:russia_nature.p: A small fluffy ginger kitten detective in a tiny deerstalker hat with a backpack standing on a hill overlooking taiga, snowy volcanoes and a deep blue lake
